name: Filament
description: A single hair-thin line wandering from corner to corner.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M2 98 C34 62 22 34 50 26 C78 18 70 -8 98 2; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M2 98 C34 62 22 34 50 26 C78 18 70 -8 98 2; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
